nome: inemaSEO 7 — Systems: build your own open Semrush

lado_card.texto: Tools measure; the groundwork and the content are what change the number. If you haven't yet, start with course 1.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning format v7.2 · eventos.inema.pro/inemaseo · inemaseo-sistemas (MIT) · inema.club

inicio.titulo: Systems: build your own open Semrush
inicio.lead: Five open, free terminal tools that do for your site what the paid suites do: a full-site audit, an AI readiness score, Search Console history, Bing AI citations, and AI bots in the log. In eight lessons you run each one, tie everything into a routine with an agent, and decide, with clear criteria, when it's worth paying.
inicio.capa_alt: Laptop with an open terminal on a dark desk, with the course title: build your own open Semrush.

numeros.t: paid API on the main path

inicio.aulas_sub: In the order of the work: understand where each piece of data comes from, run the five tools, tie everything into a routine, and decide when to pay.

itens: People who already use a terminal (or are willing to) and look after their own site or their clients' sites.
People who pay for an SEO suite, or are thinking about it, and want to know what they can do for free with their own site's data.
People who want to measure AI bots and citations with an official source, not with a dashboard number nobody explains.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Audit the whole site and get the AI readiness score, with weights you can change.
Keep Search Console data forever and read branded, non-branded, and anonymized queries week by week.
Cross-check Bing's official AI citations with Google and see which bots really read the site.
Run everything on a routine with an agent that reads the reports and only proposes, and decide when to pay for data.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in the inemaSEO Program
itens: 1 Foundation, 2 Content, and 3 Measurement: the technical groundwork, the pages only you can write, and the search numbers without your brand.
4 In the AIs, 5 With Agents, and 6 Professional: official AI dashboards, agents on the repetitive work, and SEO as a service.
7 Systems (this course): the tools that measure all of this, open at inemaseo-sistemas. You can take it after course 1.
